needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install additional street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
